---
title: "BDBV2026 data report"
subtitle: "Epi linelist and contact tracing: what arrived, how clean it is, what changed"
date: "Generated `r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B %Y, %H:%M')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    toc_depth: 2
    self_contained: true
    number_sections: false
  pdf_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    latex_engine: xelatex
    number_sections: false
params:
  repo_root: NA
  epi_run: NA
  ct_run: NA
---

<!--
HOW THIS REPORT IS MADE
=======================
One report per run (an epi + contact tracing export pair). Two halves: a short
SUMMARY for partners (key figures, data quality, what needs fixing at source,
what changed), then TECHNICAL detail for the pipeline team.

It reads ONLY
  data/processed/reports/inputs/<EPI_RUN>__<CT_RUN>/   aggregates, built on
      the server by build-report-inputs.R from the full data (no names)
  data/processed/quality_checks/                       the quality checks
never the processed exports. So the same report renders anywhere those two
folders are: as HTML on the server (pandoc only, no LaTeX), and as PDF in CI
from the git mirror (which lacks the big *_names.csv files).

Render with pipelines/report/render-report.R, not directly:
  Rscript pipelines/report/render-report.R                  # latest pair, HTML
  Rscript pipelines/report/render-report.R --epi LINELIST_26102026 --ct CONTACT_TRACING_26102026
  Rscript pipelines/report/render-report.R --pdf-missing     # CI: PDFs from bundles

Written to work in both formats: plain knitr tables (kableExtra only for PDF
column wrapping, if installed), no raw LaTeX except page breaks emitted only
for PDF.
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5, dpi = 110)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))

param_chr <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || (length(x) == 1 && is.na(x))) return(NA_character_)
  x <- as.character(x)
  if (identical(x, "NA") || !nzchar(x)) NA_character_ else x
}
repo_root <- param_chr(params$repo_root)
if (is.na(repo_root)) {
  this_file <- tryCatch(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), error = function(e) NA)
  repo_root <- if (!is.na(this_file) && nzchar(this_file))
    normalizePath(file.path(dirname(this_file), "..", "..")) else normalizePath(".")
}
epi_run <- param_chr(params$epi_run); ct_run <- param_chr(params$ct_run)
if (is.na(epi_run) || is.na(ct_run))
  stop("epi_run and ct_run are required (render-report.R supplies them).", call. = FALSE)

in_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "data", "processed", "reports", "inputs",
                    paste0(epi_run, "__", ct_run))
qc_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "data", "processed", "quality_checks")
if (!dir.exists(in_dir))
  stop("No report inputs at ", in_dir, " -- build them on the server first ",
       "(render-report.R does).", call. = FALSE)
source(file.path(repo_root, "pipelines", "quality_checks", "qc-plot-functions.R"), local = TRUE)

rd <- function(name, dir = in_dir) {
  p <- file.path(dir, name)
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(NULL)
  utils::read.csv(p, colClasses = "character", fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
                  na.strings = character(0), check.names = FALSE)
}
rl <- function(name) {
  p <- file.path(in_dir, name)
  if (file.exists(p)) readLines(p, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8") else NULL
}
num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || !length(a)) b else a
fmt <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "-", format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE))

is_pdf <- knitr::is_latex_output()
page_break <- function() if (is_pdf) knitr::asis_output("\n\\newpage\n") else invisible()

# One table helper for both formats. In PDF, long text columns wrap (with
# kableExtra if installed) instead of running off the page.
tbl <- function(d, caption = NULL, wrap = NULL, width = "9cm") {
  if (is.null(d) || !nrow(d)) return(knitr::asis_output("\n_None._\n\n"))
  if (is_pdf && requireNamespace("kableExtra", quietly = TRUE)) {
    k <- kableExtra::kbl(d, caption = caption, booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE,
                         row.names = FALSE)
    k <- kableExtra::kable_styling(k, latex_options = c("hold_position", "repeat_header"),
                                   font_size = 8)
    for (w in intersect(wrap, names(d)))
      k <- kableExtra::column_spec(k, match(w, names(d)), width = width)
    return(k)
  }
  knitr::kable(d, caption = caption, row.names = FALSE)
}

# ---- what happened in this run ----------------------------------------------
meta  <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(in_dir, "meta.json"))
rdate <- as.Date(regmatches(epi_run, regexpr("[0-9]{8}$", epi_run)), format = "%d%m%Y")
ct_date <- as.Date(regmatches(ct_run, regexpr("[0-9]{8}$", ct_run)), format = "%d%m%Y")

# Quality checks, as of this run: findings ON these exports, and history up to them.
stage_files <- c(columns = "raw_export_column_findings.csv",
                 structure = "raw_export_structure_findings.csv",
                 shares = "metrics_findings.csv")
find_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(stage_files), function(st) {
  d <- rd(stage_files[[st]], qc_dir)
  if (is.null(d) || !nrow(d)) return(NULL)
  d$stage <- st
  d[, c("dataset", "file", "export_date", "check", "severity", "column", "detail",
        "status", "stage")]
}))
on_date <- function(ds) if (ds == "epi_linelist") format(rdate) else format(ct_date)
find_now <- if (is.null(find_all))
  data.frame(dataset = character(0), file = character(0), export_date = character(0),
             check = character(0), severity = character(0), column = character(0),
             detail = character(0), status = character(0), stage = character(0)) else
  find_all[find_all$status != "expected" &
           find_all$export_date == vapply(find_all$dataset, on_date, ""), , drop = FALSE]

hist <- rd("metrics_history.csv", qc_dir)
if (!is.null(hist)) {
  hist <- qcp_metrics_types(hist)
  hist <- hist[hist$date <= max(rdate, ct_date), , drop = FALSE]
}
hval <- function(ds, src, measure, category = "", subset = "all") {
  if (is.null(hist) || is.na(src)) return(NA_real_)
  h <- hist[hist$dataset == ds & hist$source == src & hist$subset == subset &
            hist$measure == measure & hist$category == category, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(h)) as.numeric(h$n[1]) else NA_real_
}
comb_src <- if (!is.null(hist)) {
  s <- unique(hist$source[hist$dataset == "contact_tracing_combined" & hist$date == ct_date])
  if (length(s)) s[1] else NA
} else NA
```

# Summary

Epi linelist export **`r epi_run`** and contact tracing export **`r ct_run`**.
Report inputs built `r meta$built_at`.

## Key figures

```{r key-figures}
cls <- c(confirmed_case = "Confirmed", probable_case = "Probable",
         suspected_case = "Suspected", not_a_case = "Not a case", `(blank)` = "Not yet classified")
reg <- rd("pm_registry.csv")
regv <- function(m) if (is.null(reg)) NA else num(reg$value[reg$measure == m][1])
kf <- rbind(
  data.frame(Area = "Epi linelist", Figure = c("Alerts (rows)", "New since the previous export"),
             Value = c(hval("epi_linelist", epi_run, "n_rows"),
                       hval("epi_linelist", epi_run, "n_new_rows"))),
  data.frame(Area = "Epi linelist", Figure = paste0("  ", unname(cls)),
             Value = vapply(names(cls), function(k)
               hval("epi_linelist", epi_run, "case_classification", k), numeric(1))),
  data.frame(Area = "Epi linelist", Figure = "Death alerts",
             Value = hval("epi_linelist", epi_run, "type_of_alert", "death")),
  data.frame(Area = "Contact tracing", Figure = c("Contacts (all-time)", "New contacts in this export",
                                                   "Follow-up rows in this export"),
             Value = c(hval("contact_tracing_combined", comb_src, "n_contacts"),
                       hval("contact_tracing_combined", comb_src, "n_new_contacts"),
                       hval("contact_tracing", ct_run, "n_rows"))),
  data.frame(Area = "Persons", Figure = c("Distinct persons (linelist + contact tracing)",
                                          "Persons found under more than one ID"),
             Value = c(regv("persons"), regv("persons with more than one identifier"))))
kf$Value <- fmt(kf$Value)
tbl(kf)
```

## Data quality

```{r dq-status, results='asis'}
lab <- c(epi_linelist = "Epi linelist", contact_tracing = "Contact tracing (this export)",
         contact_tracing_combined = "Contact tracing (all-time table)")
for (ds in names(lab)) {
  f <- find_now[find_now$dataset == ds, , drop = FALSE]
  nc <- sum(f$severity == "critical")
  nw <- sum(f$severity == "warning")
  st <- if (nc) "**PROBLEM**" else if (nw) "**check**" else "**OK**"
  cat("- ", lab[[ds]], ": ", st, " -- ", nc, " critical, ", nw, " warning(s)\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\n")
```

```{r dq-plain, results='asis'}
# Plain-language groups for partners. Who acts on what:
SOURCE <- c("critical_missing", "column_missing", "mostly_untranslated",
            "unknown_category_values", "stale_export", "window_gap", "blank_jump",
            "duplicate_ids", "rows_dropped", "column_now_empty", "read_failed")
OURS   <- c("new_column_unmapped", "likely_renamed", "duplicate_column")
SAY <- c(
  critical_missing = "A required column is missing", column_missing = "A column is no longer in the export",
  mostly_untranslated = "Values not recognised", unknown_category_values = "New, unrecognised values",
  stale_export = "The export looks out of date", window_gap = "Gap between export windows",
  blank_jump = "Many more blank cells", duplicate_ids = "More alert IDs used on two rows",
  rows_dropped = "Fewer rows than the previous export", column_now_empty = "A column is now empty",
  read_failed = "The file could not be read", new_column_unmapped = "New column",
  likely_renamed = "Column renamed", duplicate_column = "Two columns with the same name",
  row_change = "Number of rows changed", share_change = "Mix of values changed",
  share_drift = "Mix of values drifting", column_now_filled = "A column is now being filled",
  type_change = "A column's type changed", renamed_mapped = "Column renamed (handled)",
  new_column = "New column (handled)", duplicate_rows = "More exact duplicate rows")
say <- function(f) {
  if (is.null(f) || !nrow(f)) return(cat("_None._\n\n"))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(f))) {
    what  <- unname(SAY[f$check[i]]);  if (is.na(what))  what  <- f$check[i]
    where <- unname(lab[f$dataset[i]]); if (is.na(where)) where <- f$dataset[i]
    cat("- **", what, "** (", where, ")",
        if (nzchar(f$column[i])) paste0(": ", f$column[i]),
        if (nzchar(f$detail[i])) paste0(" -- ", f$detail[i]), "\n", sep = "")
  }
  cat("\n")
}
cat("### Needs action at source (DHIS2 / data team)\n\n")
say(find_now[find_now$check %in% SOURCE, , drop = FALSE])
cat("### Changes in the data since the previous export\n\n")
say(find_now[!find_now$check %in% c(SOURCE, OURS) & find_now$severity != "info", , drop = FALSE])
cat("### For the pipeline team\n\n")
say(find_now[find_now$check %in% OURS, , drop = FALSE])
```

# Technical detail

## Pipeline steps

```{r steps, fig.height=1.9, fig.width=10}
steps <- rd("steps.csv")
# The labels: same 10 stages as the app's Run Full Pipeline tracker.
pipeline_steps <- data.frame(
  step = c("Setup", "Epi Clean", "Epi Dedup", "CT Clean", "CT IDs",
           "CT Dedup", "Name Rarity", "Person Links", "Link Ledger",
           "Registry"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
pipeline_steps$ok <- toupper(steps$ok[match(pipeline_steps$step, steps$step)]) == "TRUE"
pipeline_steps$x <- seq_len(nrow(pipeline_steps))
pipeline_steps$status <- factor(ifelse(pipeline_steps$ok, "Completed", "Not completed"),
                                levels = c("Completed", "Not completed"))
ggplot(pipeline_steps, aes(x = x, y = 1)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = max(x), y = 1, yend = 1), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               colour = "grey75", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = status), size = 14) +
  geom_text(aes(label = x), colour = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 4.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = step), y = 0.8, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", colour = "grey20") +
  geom_text(aes(label = status, colour = status), y = 0.7, size = 2.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Completed = "#198754", `Not completed` = "#dc3545"), guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.6, 1.15), xlim = c(0.5, 10.5), clip = "off") +
  theme_void()
```

## Column consistency

Which columns each DHIS2 export had, up to this run. One row per column:
**green** = renamed by us (our name shown), **orange** = no rename (raw DHIS2
name shown), **bold** = in the de-identified export shared downstream. A dot per
export that had the column; a gap = missing; a break with a new grey label =
DHIS2 renamed it.`r if (is_pdf) " (Easier to read in the HTML report, where the charts are full size.)"`

```{r col-timeline-prep}
cols_h  <- rd("raw_export_columns.csv", qc_dir)
files_h <- rd("raw_export_files.csv", qc_dir)
col_charts <- list()
if (!is.null(cols_h) && !is.null(files_h)) {
  safe <- tryCatch(qcp_safe_columns(repo_root), error = function(e) list())
  for (ds in c("epi_linelist", "contact_tracing")) {
    cutoff <- format(if (ds == "epi_linelist") rdate else ct_date)   # as of this run
    col_charts[[ds]] <- qcp_column_timeline(
      cols_h[cols_h$export_date <= cutoff, , drop = FALSE],
      files_h[files_h$export_date <= cutoff, , drop = FALSE], safe, ds,
      paste0(if (ds == "epi_linelist") "Epi linelist" else "Contact tracing",
             ": DHIS2 columns over time"))
  }
}
# Full height in HTML; in a PDF a chart cannot be taller than the page.
col_h <- function(ds) { ch <- col_charts[[ds]]
  if (is.null(ch)) 1 else if (is_pdf) min(ch$height, 9.5) else ch$height }
```

```{r col-timeline-epi, fig.height=col_h("epi_linelist"), fig.width=if (is_pdf) 10 else 16}
if (!is.null(col_charts$epi_linelist)) suppressWarnings(print(col_charts$epi_linelist$plot))
```

```{r col-timeline-ct, fig.height=col_h("contact_tracing"), fig.width=if (is_pdf) 10 else 16}
if (!is.null(col_charts$contact_tracing)) suppressWarnings(print(col_charts$contact_tracing$plot))
```

## Trends

Which charts appear, and how, is set in `pipeline_configs.json` ->
`quality_checks.report.trends`. Shares are out of all rows, blanks included.

```{r trends, results='asis'}
rcfg <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(repo_root, "pipelines", "pipeline_configs.json"),
                           simplifyVector = FALSE)$quality_checks$report
mfind <- rd("metrics_findings.csv", qc_dir)
trend_plots <- list()
for (i in seq_along(rcfg$trends)) {
  it <- rcfg$trends[[i]]
  if (is.null(hist)) break
  pr <- qcp_metrics_prepare(hist, mfind, it$dataset, measures = unlist(it$measures))
  if (is.null(pr)) next
  trend_plots[[i]] <- switch(it$view %||% "stacked",
                             lines   = qcp_metrics_lines(pr),
                             counts  = qcp_metrics_stacked(pr, "n"),
                             qcp_metrics_stacked(pr, "share"))
  h <- 2.4 * ceiling(attr(trend_plots[[i]], "n_panels") / 2) + 1.4
  cat("\n### ", it$title %||% paste(it$dataset, it$view), "\n\n", sep = "")
  # Each chart its own height: a child chunk per entry.
  cat(knitr::knit_child(text = c(sprintf("```{r trend-%d, fig.height=%.1f}", i, h),
                                 sprintf("print(trend_plots[[%d]])", i), "```"),
                        envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
}
```

## Cleaning warnings from the processing logs

Translation-table gaps and columns not recognised, as the cleaning step logged
them. Values passed through untranslated rather than dropped.

```{r log-warnings, results='asis'}
show_log_warnings <- function(log, label) {
  if (is.null(log)) return(invisible())
  cols <- grep("^Some column names not found in label list: ", log, value = TRUE)
  gaps <- c(grep("^Unmatched .+_MAP\\) values \\(\\d+ distinct\\):", log, value = TRUE),
            grep("^Unmatched .+ tokens \\(\\d+ distinct\\):", log, value = TRUE))
  if (!length(cols) && !length(gaps)) return(cat("**", label, "**: none.\n\n", sep = ""))
  cat("**", label, "**\n\n```\n", sep = "")
  for (l in c(cols, gaps)) cat(strwrap(l, 100), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n```\n\n")
}
show_log_warnings(rl("log_epi.txt"), "Epi linelist")
show_log_warnings(rl("log_ct.txt"), "Contact tracing")
```

```{r appendix, results='asis'}
for (x in list(list("log_epi.txt", epi_run), list("log_ct.txt", ct_run))) {
  lg <- rl(x[[1]])
  if (is.null(lg)) next
  cat("## ", x[[2]], "\n\n```\n", sep = "")
  cat(unlist(lapply(lg, function(l) if (nzchar(l)) strwrap(l, 100) else "")), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n```\n\n")
